edition: OOXML PresentationML (.pptx) via python-pptx 1.0.2; legacy .ppt and macro-enabled .pptm are rejected

operations.name: parse
operations.description: Extract slide text, table cells and speaker notes as fragments with slide-number citations; image-only slides marked incomplete

limitations: No OCR: image-only slides are reported as incomplete fragments, not read
Charts, SmartArt, embedded objects, slide masters/layouts and comments are not extracted
No layout fidelity; reading order is shape order, which may differ from visual order
Fixtures are generated with python-pptx; files authored in Microsoft PowerPoint are still needed for sandbox-level verification
